validated_gates: canonical metadata digest idempotence on the sample
metadata-only OpenSearch update allowlist in unit tests
no chunk text, id, ordering, hash or vector mutation in the write implementation
blocking_gates: No controlled production OpenSearch write canary has been executed.
Checkpoint and rollback have not been exercised against the production index.
The 60-document sample is intentionally capped at 750000 bytes, so it cannot establish a reliable 8.32 GB end-to-end duration or Raspberry Pi resource envelope.
The connector-internal resolver API contract is planned but not yet implemented; the current compatibility adapter depends on a read-only SQLite manifest export.
